name: Jasur Abdibayev
title: Software Engineer
headline: Backend systems · Data engineering · Scalable architecture
summary: I build production-grade software — from API design and backend services to data pipelines and analytics platforms. Focused on reliability, maintainability, and systems that scale with the business.

focusAreas.description: RESTful API design, service architecture, authentication, and asynchronous task processing.
ETL pipelines, data warehousing, analytics workflows, and visualization layers.
Containerized deployments, Linux environments, version control, and CI/CD automation.

principles: Clarity and maintainability over clever abstractions.
Systems designed for testability, observability, and long-term change.
Ship iteratively — solve real problems, measure impact, refine.
Clean boundaries between domain logic, infrastructure, and presentation.

bios.en: Software engineer focused on backend systems, data pipelines, and scalable product architecture. I work on systems that need to stay reliable under real-world load — from API layers and service design to analytics and data workflows.
bios.uz: Backend tizimlar, ma'lumotlar pipeline'lari va masshtablanadigan arxitektura ustida ishlaydigan dasturiy ta'minot muhandisi. API qatlamlari, servis dizayni va tahlil tizimlarini haqiqiy yuk ostida barqaror ishlashi uchun yarataman.
bios.ru: Инженер ПО, специализирующийся на backend-системах, data pipeline и масштабируемой архитектуре. Проектирую API, сервисы и аналитические системы, рассчитанные на стабильную работу под реальной нагрузкой.
